prompt: It’s been seen that reading for pleasure develops imaginations and better language skills than to watch TV. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In our modern society, it is widely known that reading is one of the most beneficial things, since it improves imagination abilities and helps in developing language skills, which is better than watching  TV all day without a positive outcome. However, I strongly agree with this. 

I strongly believe that spending time reading books about useful developments or things that are attractive to read will result in enhancing the function of the brain and the ability of imagination, and not only that, but also the speed level of reading and memorizing the words and the topic itself, because when teenagers, for example, read regularly it is going to increases their educational level at school rapidly. For instance, when students start reading enjoyable science books , this will benefit them by gaining more knowledge, which they can use in their classes . 

Another reason to support my argument, when individuals start purchasing books, this will enhance their language abilities by reading different types of books and ways such as  an e-book or a physical book. Since both of these types have an impact on the way of learning new academic vocabulary or phrases that they can use during their studies at university. Another clear example is that 55% of individuals in the United States read  an e-book on the internet, due to the flexibility of saving the new vocabulary into a dictionary where it can be accessed easily later.

On balance, reading books in today’s world is one of the most  crucial things students can do in order to develop their skills in general.
